title.zh: ⚡️Circle拟拓展约50个新兴市场，称稳定币进入主流规模化阶段
title.en: ⚡️Circle拟拓展约50个新兴市场，称稳定币进入主流规模化阶段

current_state.zh: Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire said stablecoin demand is surging in Southeast Asia, Latin America and the Middle East, with the company planning to expand into roughly 50 emerging markets and backing it with a $400M agreement to acquire Singapore payments firm Tazapay for local banking and payment-network access in over 100 markets.
